summary: Review since 2026-11-27 found no material new verified evidence. OECD employment impact of AI survey brief (https://doi.org/10.1787/2d7de510-en) is scheduled for December 1; await full methodology and results. November 27 AI Jobs Report combines selected employer vacancies with modeled global projections, not realized employment. NextChapter November 26 snapshot is already reviewed; secondary reporting on forward-deployed engineers does not independently establish a labor-market trend. Borri research already ingested. Postings, payroll, exposure, adoption, automation, forecasts and causal attribution remain distinct.
